scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-health-permissions.mjs minimal
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-health-permissions.mjs minimal
scripts.android:sync:minimal: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-health-permissions.mjs minimal
scripts.android:sync:full: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-health-permissions.mjs full
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:open:full: npm run android:sync:full && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:init: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
